title: Skeleton Siren Wave
description: A surreal scene featuring a woman with long flowing blue and brown hair whose lower body transforms into a glowing turquoise animal skeleton. She emerges from reflective water beside a nest containing a glowing orb. Above her, a massive cosmic wave with fiery orange, purple and blue clouds carries a small sailboat with green leaves on its sail. Floating mask-like faces appear near the wave.
prompt: Surreal fantasy scene of a beautiful woman with long flowing blue-brown hair and a glowing turquoise animal skeleton body emerging from reflective water. She stands beside a nest with a glowing pink-orange orb and dripping black roots. A massive cosmic wave of swirling orange, purple and blue clouds fills the sky, carrying a small sailboat with leafy green sails. Floating mask-like faces in the air, lush green plants in foreground, mystical atmosphere.
